info.title: td
info.description: Run only the .NET tests a change can affect: test impact analysis from your git diff, project graph and per-test-class coverage, inside your CI.

commands.name: affected
commands.description: Print the projects and tests a change affects

options.name: --base
options.description: Git ref to compare against (default: origin/main)

options.name: --repo
options.description: Any path inside the repository (default: current directory)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Write debug logs to stderr

options.name: --log-level
options.description: trace, debug, information, warning (default), error or none

options.name: --max-map-age
options.description:
Use coverage maps recorded up to n commits before the merge base,
bridging the changes in between (default: 50; 0 = only exact maps)

options.name: --maps-dir
options.description:
Coverage maps kept outside the repository, one folder per commit: record
saves there, affected and test restore the newest one within --max-map-age
(for CI systems other than GitHub Actions; see docs/ci.md)

options.name: --drift-fallback
options.description:
When the changes since an older map include a build file,
configuration or a global using, run the affected test projects
completely (all, the default) or decide them by name (name: faster,
blind to calls made through configuration or reflection)
td affected:

options.name: --tests-only
options.description: Only list affected test projects

options.name: --format
options.description:
text (default), json, paths (one .csproj per line),
or commands (one dotnet test command per test project)

options.name: --build
options.description:
When a change reaches a source generator in the repository, build the
test projects using it to compare what it generates (td test always
does); without it, an existing build newer than the sources is read
td test:

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the dotnet test commands instead of running them

options.name: --summary-file
options.description: Append a Markdown summary, e.g. to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

options.name: --shadow
options.description:
Shadow mode: select as usual, but run every test with your own dotnet test
arguments (as one command when they name a solution, a project or nothing,
otherwise per test project) and report what the selection would have left
out, for the tests that ran; needs no license and sends nothing; the exit
code is the full run's, and a TestDetta error never fails it
--shadow-no-classify Do not rerun failed classes the selection left out to tell a miss from
a flaky or pre-existing failure

options.name: --shadow-report
options.description: Shadow report file (default: .testdetta/testdetta-shadow.json)

options.name: --shadow-analysis-timeout
options.description:
Longest the analysis before the tests may take; then every test
runs without a comparison (default: 10m)

options.name: --shadow-rerun-timeout
options.description: Longest one rerun with the change may take (default: 15m)

options.name: --shadow-rerun-idle-timeout
options.description: Stop such a rerun after this long with almost no CPU (default: 5m)

options.name: --shadow-base-timeout
options.description:
Longest the rerun on the base commit may take, build
included (default: 30m)

options.name: --shadow-base-idle-timeout
options.description: Idle limit of the rerun on the base commit (default: 10m)

options.name: --shadow-classify-budget
options.description:
Longest all reruns together may take; what is left then
is reported as not classified (default: 45m)
A <time> is 90s, 15m, 1h or 1h30m; a plain number is minutes;
0 or none means no limit. The full run itself has no limit.
-- <args>            Pass the remaining arguments to every dotnet test, e.g. -- -c Release
td audit (needs no license and sends nothing; your sources and build output are never written):

options.name: --target-broken
options.description: Stop once n changes broke tests (default: 100)

options.name: --max-mutants
options.description: Stop after n changes ran tests (default: no limit)

options.name: --budget
options.description: Start no change after this long (default: 4h; 0 or none: no limit)

options.name: --parallel
options.description:
Changes tested at once, each in its own copy (default: 1; memory grows with n)
Spread each project's test classes over n processes (default: 1).
The suite must tolerate several test processes at once.

options.name: --seed
options.description: Seed of the sample order (default: 1)

options.name: --kinds
options.description: throw, return-default, flip-branch, field-value or all (default: all)

options.name: --member
options.description: Only this member (repeat for several), to reproduce a change of a report

options.name: --report
options.description: JSON report (default: .testdetta/testdetta-audit.json)

options.name: --work-dir
options.description:
Where the working copy goes (default: /tmp; the temp folder on Windows)
The working tree must have no uncommitted changes; every change is
compared with HEAD, using the coverage maps as td test does.
td record:

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration (default: Debug)

options.name: --project
options.description: Record only this test project (relative to the repository root); repeat for several

options.name: --framework
options.description: Target framework to record, e.g. net10.0 (default: the first one that runs on this machine; .NET Framework only on Windows)

options.name: --no-build
options.description:
Use the existing build output (built with the same -c) instead of building
License: set TESTDETTA_LICENSE (or TESTDETTA_LICENSE_FILE) in CI. Public repositories need none.
Without a valid license every test runs. The build never fails because of it.
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 analysis failed, 2 invalid command line, 3 tests failed (td audit: a miss).
